description: Land Title Settlement Department - Serani, Rideemaliyadda D/S Division, Badulla District - Cad. Map No. 710025
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels, their ownership status (primarily state-owned), extents, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land administration matters including title settlements, cadastral mapping, and property registrations, which squarely fits the Land Gazette classification (Type 4).
